content:
Key observations from the image:
- Leaves show small, dark brown to black spots scattered across the leaf surface
- Some leaves show yellowing around lesions and general chlorosis
- Lesions appear on both upper surfaces; small, irregularly shaped dark spots
- Some spots have coalesced into larger blotches
- Lower/middle canopy leaves appear most affected
- No white mold, no stem cankers, no vein necrosis pattern, no pustules visible
- The pattern is small, scattered, dark brown irregular lesions with some yellowing

This pattern matches **Septoria_brown_spot** well: small, irregularly shaped dark brown lesions on leaf surfaces that coalesce into larger blotches, with leaf yellowing, affecting the lower/middle canopy.

The spots are too dark and irregular for Frogeye (which has gray centers with reddish borders). No angular vein-limited pattern of Bacterial_Blight. No pustules for Bacterial_Pustule. No reddish-purple bronzing of Cercospora.
